answer: Attention Ledger Scoring requires each identity to hold a live jetty of witnessed task-hours, logging continuous engagement that cannot be pre-bought in bulk. The rule: reputation only accrues while an identity's attention ledger stays unbroken across random onyx-marked audit windows, so each sybil must staff its own sustained presence. Every duplicate identity therefore pays a fixed bridge cost in genuine operator hours plus the idle time of standing by between audits, making mass fabrication economically worse than hiring one honest worker.
